# model version tag

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:modelVersionTag`](gmeow-modelVersionTag.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/modelVersionTag>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The provider's wire-level version identifier for the described snapshot. Citation-grade version identity rides DOI/version identity machinery's DOI machinery.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:modelVersionTag`](gmeow-modelVersionTag.md) from [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the provider's wire-level version string for the snapshot a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) describes — the exact identifier a [`gmeow:ModelInvocation`](../classes/gmeow-ModelInvocation.md) can be matched against.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for citation-grade version identity (that rides the DOI/version-identity machinery) and avoid treating two different version tags as the same model snapshot.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:modelVersionTag`](gmeow-modelVersionTag.md) as the provider's exact version string on the [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md); pair with the DOI machinery when a stable, citable version identity is required.

### Examples

- ex:opusCard [`gmeow:modelVersionTag`](gmeow-modelVersionTag.md) "claude-opus-4-8[1m]".
